violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is using raw shelled eggs for desserts that are cooked and cooled. PIC has stated they will discontinue the used of raw shelled eggs. If establishment chooses to continue to use raw shelled eggs, PIC to obtain food safety certificate and register an individual with the Rhode Island Certified Food Safety Manager License. Updated food safety plan will also be required. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw shelled eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as deli meats, cheese and fruit in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Establishment was observed selling bottled juices with tamper evident cap. Establishment is not approved for this process. Juices were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. If establishment chooses to proceed with method, plans must be submitted to RIDOH CFP and approved prior to implementing. https://health.ri.gov/food-safety/specialized-processes-retail-food-establishments Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is using raw shelled eggs for desserts that are cooked and cooled. PIC has stated they will discontinue the used of raw shelled eggs. If establishment chooses to continue to use raw shelled eggs, PIC to obtain food safety certificate and register an individual with the Rhode Island Certified Food Safety Manager License. Updated food safety plan will also be required. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw shelled eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as deli meats, cheese and fruit in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

Deli meat, cheese, cream cheese were observed held at 49 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Time/temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of. Refrigerator was taken out of service to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine/ beverage dispenser have an accumulation of orange and white residue. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice dispenser have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2025

The ceiling by the front door is in poor repair and was observed leaking. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Landlord was on premise and was scheduling repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/21/2023
